criterion: Recovery: easy to undo or go back
description: A saved identity cannot be edited anywhere. The profile has no edit control, and `client identity` with corrected values returns IDENTITY_EXISTS. A typo such as a missing domain suffix is permanent unless the person discards the whole client directory and its projects.
expected: A way to correct the display name and email (at least before any project exists, ideally anytime, propagated to project profiles).
actual: Profile dialog shows only Close; CLI returns IDENTITY_EXISTS "Identity already initialized; linking requires My device".
suggested_fix: Add an identity update operation (UI Edit in the You dialog plus `client identity --update`), or at minimum allow replacing the identity while no project exists.

description: Email validation accepts "tomas@fernhill" (no dot in the domain), in both the browser and the server, so an obvious typo is saved silently.
expected: Warn or reject a domain without a dot, or ask the person to confirm.
actual: Saved as tomas@fernhill with no warning.
suggested_fix: Require a dot in the domain part (or show a soft 'Did you mean…?' warning) in profile() and the form.

description: IDENTITY_EXISTS reads "Identity already initialized; linking requires My device", which is irrelevant to someone trying to correct their email.
expected: State that the identity is already set, show the current values, and say how (or whether) it can be changed.
actual: "IDENTITY_EXISTS: Identity already initialized; linking requires My device"
suggested_fix: Reword it to e.g. "This client already has an identity (Tomás Rivera, tomas@fernhill). To use another computer as the same person, link it with a My device invitation."

criterion: Long content: layout absorbs the longest value
description: A long unbroken name makes the Continue button label ("Continue as …") and the form grow past the viewport: pageOverflowX 1048 px, spills on #root, main.client-entry and form.
expected: The button label truncates with an ellipsis (or wraps), and the form stays within its column.
actual: Inputs, error box and button run off the right edge; horizontal page scroll.
suggested_fix: Give the client-entry form min-width:0 / max-width, and give the button label overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis (or overflow-wrap:anywhere).

description: A name over 200 characters is rejected with "Supply a name", which doesn't mention the length limit and contradicts what the person typed.
expected: "Use a name of 200 characters or fewer." (and maxLength on the input).
suggested_fix: Return a length-specific message and add maxLength to the inputs.

description: The profile labels typed values as "Git name" / "Git email" even when Git provided nothing and the person entered them by hand.
suggested_fix: Rename the labels to Name / Email.
